author: Learn Linux TV
description:
Most cloud disasters come from the same handful of habits, not bad luck. In this video, I cover five cloud "worst practices" I see over and over: weak monitoring, runaway spending, sloppy security, no governance, and treating one tool as the answer to everything. If any of these sound familiar, here's how to spot them and fix them before they cost you.
